experiences.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace & Hanbok Experience
experiences.description: Explore the grand Joseon-era Gyeongbokgung Palace while dressed in a traditional Hanbok rental. Wearing Hanbok grants free palace entry, and you can stroll through the historic grounds, visit the National Folk Museum inside, and capture stunning photos at the iconic gates and pavilions.

experiences.name: Gwangjang Market Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Dive into Seoul's oldest traditional market and feast on iconic Korean street foods including bindaetteok (mung bean pancakes), mayak gimbap (addictive mini rice rolls), tteokbokki, and fresh yukhoe (beef tartare). This is a beloved local food experience that immerses you in authentic Korean culinary culture.

experiences.name: K-Pop Idol Experience & SM Town COEX Artium
experiences.description: Visit SM Town COEX Artium, a K-pop cultural hub featuring hologram concerts, artist exhibitions, merchandise, and interactive K-pop experiences. Afterward, explore the surrounding COEX Mall and catch a live busking performance or fan meet event in the K-pop hotspot district of Gangnam.

experiences.name: Insadong & Bukchon Hanok Village Cultural Walk
experiences.description: Wander through the charming Bukchon Hanok Village, a preserved neighborhood of traditional Korean wooden houses (hanok) with stunning views of the city. Then stroll down Insadong's artsy alleyways filled with tea houses, traditional craft shops, galleries, and street performers for a deep dive into Korean heritage and contemporary culture.

experiences.name: Korean BBQ & Soju Night in Hongdae
experiences.description: Experience the quintessential Korean dining ritual of samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly) and galbi (beef short ribs) at a lively local BBQ restaurant in Hongdae. Pair the meal with soju and makgeolli, then explore Hongdae's vibrant nightlife, K-indie live music clubs, and street performances that define Seoul's youthful K-culture scene.
